segments.name: North America
segments.description: Sells branded performance apparel, footwear and accessories to wholesale customers, licensees and consumers through Brand and Factory House stores and e-commerce in the United States and Canada.
segments.evidence: We sell our apparel, footwear and accessories in North America through wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels.

segments.name: EMEA
segments.description: Sells branded performance apparel, footwear and accessories to wholesale customers and independent distributors and to consumers through e-commerce and Brand and Factory House stores.
segments.evidence: We sell our apparel, footwear and accessories in EMEA primarily through wholesale customers and independent distributors, as well as through e-commerce platforms and Brand and Factory House stores we operate within Europe.

segments.name: Asia-Pacific
segments.description: Sells branded performance apparel, footwear and accessories through partner-operated stores, owned stores, e-commerce platforms and distributors across Asia-Pacific markets.
segments.evidence: We sell our apparel, footwear and accessories products in China, South Korea, Australia, Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand through stores operated by our distribution and wholesale partners, as well as through e-commerce platforms and Brand and Factory House stores that we own and operate.

segments.name: Latin America
segments.description: Sells branded performance apparel, footwear and accessories in Mexico through wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels and elsewhere through independent distributors.
segments.evidence: We sell our apparel, footwear and accessories in Mexico through wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels.

revenueModel.text: Retailers, distributors, licensees and consumers pay the company for branded performance apparel, footwear and accessories sold through wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate net revenues from the sale of our products to national, regional, independent and specialty retailers and distributors worldwide.

changes.text: In Fiscal 2025, the company's MapMyFitness digital platform was sold, removing its results from Corporate Other.
changes.evidence: operating results related to our MapMyFitness digital platform, which was sold during the second quarter of Fiscal 2025

changes.text: In Fiscal 2026, restructuring costs included non-cash contract termination charges primarily relating to the separation of the Curry Brand.
changes.evidence: Other restructuring costs for Fiscal 2026 include $69.7 million of non-cash contract termination costs, primarily relating to the separation of the Curry Brand.
